use_case: Water-quality anomaly detection: flags unusual water quality and hydraulic patterns (chlorine residual, pH, turbidity, conductivity, pressure, flow) for operator review
business_owner: Senior Vice President, Water Quality and Environmental Compliance
vendor_or_model: Vendor water-quality analytics model, configured and tuned by the data science team
data_categories: Process and water quality data from historian replicas (no personal information)
affects_individuals: Yes (indirectly: about 1.24 million people at GCR plus 2 pilot systems)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only: operators confirm every alert with grab samples and SCADA trends before acting; SCADA and hardwired alarms remain the controls of record
applicable_laws: SDWA section 1433 (part of the automated systems in the RRA and a detection strategy in the ERP, 42 U.S.C. 300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii), (b)(4)); 40 CFR Part 141 compliance monitoring stays with approved methods and certified laboratories, not the model
status: In production at GCR; pilot at 2 systems
write_path_to_ot: None (read-only dashboard; no write path to SCADA)
testing_status: GCR: local back-test on 46 labeled events; pilots: vendor data only (gap)
monitoring: Monthly alert precision; quarterly recall review against confirmed events; drift monitoring not yet in place (POAM-022)

data_categories: Raw water quality and process data

testing_status: Vendor validation plus 6-month shadow comparison with jar tests at TP-A
monitoring: Weekly comparison of recommendations with operator doses; out-of-bounds recommendations logged
